title: A DOOR OPENED FOR THE PARTY OPENS FOR THE ENEMIES TOO
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In co-op, after the host died or extracted, his window keeps the raid running for player 2. If player 2 then opened a locked room with a key, it opened on his screen only: in the raid the host runs, the door stayed shut, so every machine and pillager still treated the doorway as a wall. They could not see him through it or walk in, while his shots from inside still landed, and a third player never got the door at all. The raid the host keeps now opens the door too and passes it on to the rest of the party.
now: In co-op, a door opened with a key while the host watches opens for everyone, enemies included.
